points.description: States that a stack is a data structure (a collection that stores elements/items).
States that the last item added is the first to be removed (last-in-first-out / LIFO). Equivalent wording, e.g. 'most recently added element is removed first', earns the marks.
points.partial_credit: Award 2 marks if only the acronym LIFO is given with no explanation, or if the ordering is described imprecisely but is clearly last-in/first-out in intent.
